title: Cars.com - 2023 Genesis Electrified G80 review
notes: Relays Genesis figures: 87.2 kWh battery, 800-volt charging, 10-80 % in about 22 min on a 350 kW charger but the car accepts a maximum of 187 kW, home charging 10.9 kW (0-100 % in about 7 h 22 min at 48 A). US car. InsideEVs (insideevs.com/news/654410/genesis-electrified-g80-epa-range-price/) and Motor1/InsideEVs reviews give the same 187 kW and 22 min.
